units: Decorative composition ratio. Width of the dated cartouche equals 1. The assembled illustration multiplies every linear value by 4.
origin: X zero on the inscription centreline; Z zero at the common displayed sill. Face Y grows inward.
method: Four shallow brick panels have a narrow edge and a shaded return above the four crown windows. The visible panel widths relative to the opening below are approximately 0.88, 0.88, 0.94, 0.95. The heads beneath canvas are inferred from their jambs and the exposed pair. Panel centering, recess and canopy projection are illustration choices.
wall_connection: Cut at each listed outer rectangle. The moulded surround starts just behind the wall face. Its backing lies at face_y + depth, and the reverse reaches face_y + 1.35 * depth. Allow at least 1.5 times the selected depth behind the front of the surrounding wall.
